from pathlib import Path
# ensure no Load Trace left in user-visible web files outside historical fixtures documentation
for p in Path('web').rglob('*'):
    if p.suffix not in {'.html', '.js'}: continue
    if 'usability' in p.parts and p.name != 'load-button-trajectory.html' and p.name != 'desktop-start-instructions.html' and p.name != 'desktop-params-glosses.html':
        continue  # historical fixtures ok
    text = p.read_text(errors='ignore')
    if p.name in {'index.html', 'viewer.js', 'load-button-trajectory.html', 'desktop-start-instructions.html', 'desktop-params-glosses.html'}:
        if 'Load Trace' in text and p.name in {'index.html', 'viewer.js', 'desktop-start-instructions.html'}:

            if p.name == 'desktop-start-instructions.html':
                # before section may still mention in prose? check after card

            else:

        if p.name == 'index.html':
            assert 'load-btn-label">Load<' in text
            assert 'Back to trajectory selection' in text
print('ok')
